STATEMENT H

GREAT LAKES REGION
MINNEAPOLIS OFFICE
6301 34TH AVENUE SOUTH
MINNEAPOLIS, MINNESOTA 55450
AUG 1 3 1973
August 3, 1973
Mr. I. C. Herried Chief, Development Engineer Wisconsin Division of Highways 4802 Sheboygan Avenue Madison, Wisconsin 53702
1030-1-00 3015-1-00 CC: MMB TJM TJM TICM HKB De#9
Draft Environmental Impact Statement
Proposed Milwaukee Airport Spur - General Mitchell Field
Milwaukee, Wisconsin
Dear Mr. Herried;
This is in response to your request for comments on the Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the above mentioned airport.
Without choosing between the alternatives we feel there should be a better development of the third complete paragraph on page 82. The claim that relocation is a benefit to those people moved appears to be unsubstantiated. If this were to be done it would involve canvassing an approximate 154 houses and commercial units.
We appreciate the opportunity to review this Draft Impact Statement and hope we have helped you in some way.
Sincerely,
Chief, Planning Section
Response to Comments:
1. This has been deleted in the Final E.I.S.
